miniPosts.title: The Hidden Courtyards of Berlin: A Walk Through the Höfe Around Hackescher Markt
miniPosts.summary: Behind the facades around Hackescher Markt, Berlin hides a second layer: connected inner courtyards, the Höfe, that most visitors walk straight past. Here is which passages to step into and in what order, from the tiled Hackesche Höfe to a street-art courtyard, a rose garden and a hand-made candy workshop, all within a ten-minute walk.
miniPosts.alt: The illuminated Art Nouveau tiled facade of the first courtyard of the Hackesche Höfe in Berlin at night.
